youtube_title: Everything on Sale... How Do They Still Earn? 🛒 #Shorts
youtube_description:
'70% OFF' everywhere, so how do companies still make money?

1) Volume: Redseer estimates about ₹24,000 crore of online sales in just the first 2 days of the 2026 festive season. 2) Some prices go up before the sale, so the 'discount' only cancels the hike: Techarc checked 50 phones in a July 2026 sale and 68% still cost more than their launch price. 3) Sales clear old stock and bring in new buyers for the whole year.

Rule: track prices for weeks, compare with the launch price, buy only what's on your list.
Moral: A discount you didn't need is not saving.

Sources: Redseer via BW Disrupt (Oct 2026); Techarc (Jul 2026).
